findings.title: Ingress has no controller
findings.cause: Ingress web asks for IngressClass nginx-internal, which does not exist (the cluster has kd-faults), so no controller serves it

evidence.command: kubectl get ingress web -n kd-ingress-class-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.ingressClassName}'

findings.fix: Set ingressClassName to an installed class, or install the ingress controller the class belongs to (and mark one class default if Ingresses omit it).
